title: Devices are running unsupported Windows builds

activeDays.text: Days within which a device must have checked in to count

report.title: {Items.Count} active {Plural(Items.Count, 'device is', 'devices are')} on an unsupported Windows build

messages.businessImpact: No security updates are being issued for these builds at all, so every vulnerability found from now on remains open on these machines permanently.
remediation: Establish why they have not updated: a deferral, a feature update policy target, or a failing upgrade.
Where hardware cannot take a supported build, treat it as a replacement list with a date.
messages.cannotSee: A device on a build the Windows build list does not hold is passed over rather than called out of support, so a build newer than the list, or one the vendor has not recorded, costs the check rather than producing a finding nobody can act on.
